verdict.rationale: Zep's first-party docs say JSON, text, and messages are all ingestible data types for a Context Graph, and that it builds the graph from chat messages, business data, documents, and JSON. An older community note that Zep focused on conversation history describes earlier positioning; it does not show that non-chat ingestion fails. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific non-message ingestion API and its limits (e.g. document size or chunking), and independent or hands-on corroboration of document and JSON ingestion.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ingest documents, JSON, and business data into memory — not just chat transcripts
